people.name: Ashdod
people.line: A major Philistine city, known for Dagon worship.

people.name: Ashkelon
people.line: A major Philistine city, often a target of prophecy.

people.name: Ekron
people.line: One of the five major Philistine city-states

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will cut off the ruler of Ashdod and the one who wields the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord Jehovah.
